# Denver7

> > Denver7 is Colorado's leading local news source covering Denver metro area news, politics, weather, public safety, and community events.

Denver7 provides comprehensive coverage of Colorado news including local politics like the gubernatorial race featuring George Brauchler, environmental issues in neighborhoods like Elyria-Swansea, public safety incidents including the Aurora theater shooting, and cultural events throughout the Denver metro area and mountain communities.

## Key Topics

- Colorado news and politics
- Denver metro area coverage
- George Brauchler and 2018 gubernatorial race
- Aurora theater shooting and James Holmes
- Environmental issues and pollution (zip code 80216)
- Transgender rights and education policy
- 18th Judicial District
- Arapahoe County, Douglas, Elbert, Lincoln counties
- Colorado weather and snowstorms
- Mountain community events (Loveland, Breckenridge)
- Public safety and explosions
- Entertainment and cultural events
- Cirque du Soleil performances
- Republican candidates and district attorneys

- [Mother of transgender daughter questions changes](https://www.denver7.com/news/local-news/local-mother-questions-transgender-guideline-change): Denver mother responds to Trump admin reversing transgender bathroom policy
